name: Pursuant
description: The Pursuant was a Quasar Fire-class cruiser-carrier in service to the Imperial Navy during the Imperial Era. At some point, the cruiser-carrier flew over a land-and-water-covered terrestrial body alongside TIE/ln space superiority starfighters. The Pursuant measured 340 meters (1,116 feet) in length and was equipped with sublight engines and four hangar bays, in which it carried TIE series starships.
